about: A library that fills Word templates with data, in Node or the browser.

prs.title: List loops over several paragraphs leave no template text behind
prs.broken: A repeating list that spanned three or more paragraphs left a copy of the raw template paragraph at the top of the output.
prs.changed: Every original template paragraph is now removed after the list is filled in.
prs.matters: Generated documents contain only the filled-in items.
